title: POTATO CROQUETTES
instructions: --Take four boiled potatoes and add to them half their weight in butter, the same quantity of powdered sugar,  salt, grated peel of half a lemon and two well beaten eggs. Mix thoroughly and roll into cork-shaped pieces and dip into the beaten yolks of eggs, rolling in sifted bread-crumbs. Let stand one hour and again dip in egg and roll in crumbs. Fry in boiling lard or butter. Serve with a garnish of parsley.
